messages:
mica: Dropping a new mock for the throughput + latency panel — added a p95/p99 toggle, live scrubber, and an optional pattern overlay for low-intensity heatmap bands. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123 — please scan for copy and accessibility issues.
kyle: Nice layout. Question: should the toggle be labeled 'P95 / P99' or 'Tail percentile'? I'd prefer explicit labels like 'P95 | P99' so theres no ambiguity. Also default to P95 for dashboards by default (most teams look at p95).
frida: Agree explicit. Copy proposal for tooltip: 'Choose which tail percentile to display. P99 highlights rare, extreme latency; P95 shows the typical slow tail.' Keep it short.
dante: Scrubber behavior: when you drag, the tooltip currently flickers and loses keyboard focus. Need to keep the scrubber control focusable and provide `aria-valuetext` like 'Time 12:03 — Throughput 240 req/s, P95 120ms'. Also add snapline options: none, event, minute.
anya: On throughput axis label: use 'Throughput (req/s)' instead of 'Requests' to be explicit about units. Same for timezone: use user's locale zone in tooltip and an optional UTC toggle.
a11y-bot: Color checks: the pattern overlay helps colorblind users but ensure patterns are discrete (dots vs stripes) and toggled via a keyboard-accessible control. Also heatmap low-intensity color fails contrast when used with small legend text. Recommend larger legend type or outline on numbers.
kyle: For legend wording, instead of 'density' use 'Requests per min' and include min/max examples in the hover: 'range 0750 requests/min'.
frida: Microcopy tweak for scrubber: change 'Pause live updates' to 'Pause live updates for inspection' for clarity. For the percentile toggle tooltip: 'Switch the tail percentile used to compute latency.'
dante: Keyboard nav for scrubber: left/right arrows move 1s, shift+arrows move 10s, home/end go to start/end. Announce changes via a single `aria-live="polite"` summary region updated with short text, e.g., 'Now showing 12:03 — P95 120ms'. Avoid verbose announcements.
mica: (typo) meant mica: Also request that hover tooltips include a small 'link to logs' action when a spike is selected — show `Open logs` button with aria-label 'Open logs for selected time'.
anya: UX question: where to surface the pattern overlay toggle? top toolbar makes sense but might increase clutter. Suggest putting it in a 'Display' dropdown with toggle items: 'Color scale', 'Pattern overlay', 'Percentile selector'.
kyle: Small copy nit: use sentence case for toolbar items, e.g., 'Pattern overlay' not 'Pattern Overlay'. Screen reader reads better that way.
a11y-bot: Focus order: ensure the percentile toggle, display dropdown, presets, and scrubber read in a logical left-to-right order. Check with keyboard-only walkthrough.
frida: Action items: 1) I'll update tooltip copy + scrubber microcopy in Figma; 2) dante will spec keyboard increments and aria-live text; 3) kyle will change legend wording and unit examples; 4) mica will add pattern assets and the display dropdown.
dante: Timeline? aiming to have figma updates by Wednesday and small frontend PRs the following week.
mica: Thanks all, I'll post updated frames and tag for final pass. :white_check_mark:
